Papp L Roy & Associates Has Cut Stake in Qualcomm (QCOM) by $743,040 as Stock Price Declined; As Parsley Energy (PE) Stock Value Declined, Kelly Lawrence W & Associates Has Upped Position
May 19, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Papp L Roy & Associates decreased its stake in Qualcomm Inc (QCOM) by 17.32% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Papp L Roy & Associates sold 11,610 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.28% with the market. The institutional investor held 55,435 shares of the radio and television broadcasting and communications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.55 million, down from 67,045 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Papp L Roy & Associates who had been investing in Qualcomm Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $85.27B market cap company. The stock increased 0.98% or $0.56 during the last trading session, reaching $57.51. About 10.20 million shares traded. QUALCOMM Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) has declined 3.21% since May 19, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.76% the S&P500.
